name: Guangzhou Anyka Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Anyka Microelectronics Co., Ltd. engages in the design and sale of AI System-on-a-Chip (SoC) chips that enable AI hardware in China. The company offers IoT camera chips, including the AK39AV130 series multi-view low-power intelligent camera chip, KM01 series AOV low-power intelligent vision chip, and KM02 series edge computing intelligent vision chip; low-power Bluetooth chips comprising AK1080 and AK1090 Bluetooth audio chips and SF32LB series chips for wearable devices; human interaction chips that include the AK2659 vision processing chip; and power management chips, such as the AK5301 chip, a photovoltaic charging management device.
